scenes.narration: What earns Amazon more profit than every package it ships combined?
Its cloud business, Amazon Web Services. It rents computer power to apps and AI companies.
In 2025, AWS was just 18 percent of Amazon's sales. But it made 57 percent of the operating profit.
That's 45.6 billion dollars of operating income from the cloud.
So the boxes get the attention. The servers pay the bills.
